consequence.statement: Where GOMAXPROCS is not explicitly set, the Go runtime now sets it dynamically for the controller pods, so controller CPU concurrency is no longer fixed; the release notes state no failure.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; if the previous fixed GOMAXPROCS behavior is needed, set the GOMAXPROCS environment variable explicitly on the controller containers.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 lets the Go runtime dynamically set GOMAXPROCS for the Flux controllers, changing how controller CPU concurrency is determined.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for env-var behavior-changed
